our menus

SRI LANKAN MENU

STARTERS

Fish Cutlets (3pcs)

£4.50

£4.25

Coconut Roti(vg) (2pcs)

Sri Lankan style flat bread made with fresh coconut served with seeni sambol (Onions fried with a mix of spices, chili flakes and a hint of sugar

£5.50

FRIED RICE

Tongue tingling mixes of the best ingredients, ready for your enjoyment

Lion’s Special

Chef’s special rice with chicken, pork, beef, prawns, squids & vegetable stir fried mixed with Chef’s special spicy mix

Annasi Maaluwa (vg)

Juicy pineapple chunks cooked in coconut milk and infused with sri lankan authentic spices

Black Pork Curry

Pork cooked with a mix of Sri Lanka Spices, the colour is derived from a dark roasted curry powder

SUSHI

apanese rolls that are rolled with seaweed and japanese sushi rice

Prawn Tempura, eel, avocado & Mayonnaise, sprinkled with crispy tempura crunches and finished with a drizzle of Unagi sauce.

coming from the japanese word Imono.” ura maki”
meaning inverted sushi rolls, they ’ll make your taste buds go crazy.

Makimono HOSO Maki (Nori outside) 6pcs
Kappa Maki(v) cucumber roll

£4.50
